prediction.frozen: textual, and the most likely of the three to also register a route-path hit. All three lanes edit the same procedure, post.list, in src/server/routers/post.ts: two add input fields to the same z.object and one probably adds a sibling search procedure. Convention hits: 0 ordinals, 0-1 route paths (two lanes could both name a new procedure 'search' or 'list'), 0-1 config keys. Stealth false. What would surprise me: a clean merge with a failing suite, which is the semantic class and would be the first unseeded one.
